scripts.dist: rm -rf ./dist/vk-site-builder/ ./dist/vk-site-builder.zip && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist && npm run dist:copy && npm run zip
scripts.dist:copy: mkdir -p dist/vk-site-builder && cp -R vk-site-builder.php readme.txt inc patterns assets vendor dist/vk-site-builder/
scripts.phpunit: composer install && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd='wp-content/plugins/vk-site-builder' vendor/bin/phpunit -c .phpunit.xml
